findings.limits: Production SensorSource port with in-process fixture family, not physical sensor evidence.

findings.title: A registered family hid unresolved stops when its live capture disappeared
findings.verifiedReasoning: unresolved_stops excluded an entire registered generation. It now hides only matching currently visible capture scopes; absent captures remain visible.
findings.limits: Production SensorSource port with in-process fixture family, not physical sensor evidence.

findings.title: Direct phone stop/removal lost unresolved capture across restart
findings.verifiedReasoning: Per-device mobile_sensors_stop bypassed canonical journal; teardown removed ConnState before the generic source could see capture. Latest fix snapshots a private source-generation owner at attachment; mobile_note_mic_state writes raw evidence before mic_since is exposed, irrespective of enabled projection. Same valid connection false can confirm only exact scope. try_read source registration rejects removed/replaced generations and avoids await under the connection lock; unowned captures retain a sticky overflow warning. Direct stop also routes the canonical stop path. Read-only review confirmed these call paths.
findings.limits: Real production mobile TLS and persistent Runtime ports with simulated phone. Restart here reconstructs Runtime from the same disk home; whole native daemon-process restart is a separate unexecuted N6 driver for the parent.

findings.title: A pre-operation poll overwrote a successfully completed preset
findings.verifiedReasoning: runHostPreset now invalidates earlier preferences reads when the operation starts.
findings.limits: React component plus controlled desktop promises/events. Native host crash/reconnect walkthrough evidence belongs to parent.

findings.title: Reconnect recovery left preset/proactive readback stale
findings.verifiedReasoning: Host result events and connection/refresh invalidations now reload preferences and proactive state; the actual component reconciles an unverified operation after reconnect.
findings.limits: React component plus controlled desktop promises/events. Native host crash/reconnect walkthrough evidence belongs to parent.

findings.title: A poll issued during a host operation overwrote its later completion
findings.verifiedReasoning: Start-only generation invalidation did not cover a prefsGet issued after start. Completion now advances the generation before exposing the final preset response; a late read cannot replace it.
findings.limits: Independent added delayed-promise regression; parent implements fix and broader suite. Not an OS-scheduler race stress test.

findings.title: Atomic replacement widened private preference-file permissions
findings.verifiedReasoning: save_prefs_at applies existing file mode intersected with 0600 (default 0600) before create_new. Independent reread verified write/sync/rename ordering and post-commit directory sync behavior.
findings.limits: Temporary filesystem permission test on macOS; no permissions on user files were changed.

findings.title: Failed create_new cleanup deleted a pre-existing temporary path
findings.verifiedReasoning: Cleanup ownership is acquired only after successful create_new. A collision leaves the existing unrelated path untouched; cleanup is conditional on the created flag.
findings.limits: Deterministic owned test directory collision, not a claim to exhaustive concurrent filesystem fault coverage.
